website.error: Corporate site (stereotaxis.com) describes commercial robotic magnetic navigation systems and catheters; no drug/biologic pipeline page exists

ctgov.note: Both Stereotaxis-sponsored ctgov studies (NCT01131793 PowerAssert RF, NCT01656772 Vdrive) are COMPLETED (last primary completion 2013); no active P1/P2/P3 trials

commercial_product.description: Stereotaxis is a medical device company that designs, manufactures and markets a robotic magnetic navigation (RMN) platform for minimally invasive endovascular interventions, primarily cardiac electrophysiology ablation.

marketed_products.name: Genesis RMN System
marketed_products.description: Next-generation robotic magnetic navigation system for remotely steering catheter tips with externally applied magnetic fields

marketed_products.name: Niobe ES
marketed_products.description: Prior-generation RMN system, installed base in ~100+ hospitals globally

marketed_products.name: MAGiC catheter
marketed_products.description: Proprietary robotically navigated magnetic ablation catheter; received regulatory clearance in Europe in 2025 and U.S. approval in early 2026 as replacement for legacy Biosense Webster J&J catheters

marketed_products.name: MAGiC Sweep
marketed_products.description: First robotically navigated high-density EP mapping catheter; received FDA 510(k) clearance

marketed_products.name: Map-iT diagnostic catheters
marketed_products.description: Portfolio of differentiated diagnostic mapping catheters acquired via APT, cleared in U.S. and Europe

marketed_products.name: Cardiodrive / QuikCAS
marketed_products.description: Automated catheter advancement system used with the RMN System

marketed_products.name: Odyssey / Synchrony & SynX
marketed_products.description: Information and integration solutions for the EP lab

regulatory_in_progress.name: EMAGIN 5F catheter guide
regulatory_in_progress.status: Seeking regulatory clearance; designed to robotically navigate tortuous venous anatomy. Regulatory submission only — not a P1/P2/P3 clinical study.

excluded_legacy_terminated.trial: NCT01131793 PowerAssert RF Guidewire (Phase 2, coronary CTO)
NCT01656772 Vdrive Lasso EP (Phase 3, atrial fibrillation)

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Stereotaxis is a commercial-stage medical device company (robotic magnetic navigation systems and ablation/mapping catheters for cardiac electrophysiology). Its product portfolio is FDA-cleared/approved and marketed; there are no active company-sponsored P1/P2/P3 clinical studies. The two Stereotaxis-sponsored ctgov trials both completed over a decade ago. Ongoing regulatory work (e.g., EMAGIN 5F) is 510(k)/clearance work rather than a phased clinical trial.
